_about: Sea step 9b the 7 traversal tools (LOCKED list; game/sea_tools.gd). Each player owns his own (profile extra sea_tools); a dungeon chest with `tool` gives it to every player inside. T uses the chosen tool, Y picks the next one. grapple: aim at a hook ring within range_m (view cone cone_deg) -> pulled there at pull_speed. bell: reveals fog walkways within range_m for reveal_s (the host's clock) and thins the sea fog for the ringer. gauntlet: an ember bolt (range_m) burns brambles, lights braziers. anchor: an ice slab (size_m) on water within range_m (dungeon pools or the sea) for life_s, at most max at once. glider: hold jump in the air: fall at most fall_speed, forward at speed; updraft vents lift at lift m/s up to lift_h over the vent. pearl: at a tide basin within range_m raises / lowers the dungeon's tide; carried, swimming breath lasts breath_mult as long. compass: shows the way to the nearest whorl door within point_m; within range_m opens it. ALL NUMBERS MINE.
